fields.Name: T252 - Tags Synonym Add and Remove
fields.Description: Exercises the synonym add/remove mutation path (AddSynonym/RemoveSynonym) — a create+delete round-trip against the tag-synonym store, distinct from tree navigation.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo), open 'Tags', go to the Taxonomy Tree view, and select a tag node so its details panel appears. Find the 'Synonyms' section for the selected tag, type a new synonym name (e.g. 'genai-test') into the add-synonym input, and click the '+ Add' button. Success is that the new synonym appears in the synonym list for that tag; then click its remove (x) control and confirm it disappears. Seeing the synonym round-trip (add then remove) is the goal. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A synonyms editor is available for a selected tag with an add-synonym input and Add button
Adding a synonym makes it appear in the tag's synonym list, and removing it makes it disappear (a round-trip)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
